summary:
I submitted five attempts, based on reading the inventory module and the complete-cart flow. I never saw any of their results, so I am not claiming any as a confirmed problem. I stopped with 25 attempts and 81 turns unused.

1. **Shared item across lines:** one cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 12 WIDGET units against 10 in stock. I suspect `ensureInventoryLevels` checks each line on its own, so both lines pass (per-line-check, expecting no_oversell to fail).
2. **Same cart on two servers:** the cart lock is in-memory, so it may not stop a double completion across processes (process-local-lock, expecting one_order_per_cart to fail).
3. **Same cart three times on one server:** a check on the in-process lock and the existing-order guard (duplicate-completion, expecting one_order_per_cart to fail).
4. **Many WIDGET carts on two servers:** `createReservationItems_` writes `reserved_quantity` from a value it read earlier, so an update could be lost (stale-counter-write, expecting reserved_matches_reservations to fail).
5. **Ten SOLO carts racing for one unit across two servers:** with no cross-process serialization, both servers may reserve the last unit (process-local-lock, expecting no_oversell to fail).

I did not test stock-location-mixup. The scenario format has no way to set up more than one stock location, and I could not trigger a location mismatch.
